## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407/blob/04d8a90549d23fc6bd7f642064003592df51e9b3/README.md): Context length stated on the official model card.</sub>

<pre>
download                      size  score
4-bit q4_0                 ~7.85GB   44.4
4-bit q4_k_m               ~7.85GB   44.4
8-bit q8_0                 ~15.2GB   44.4
4-bit Q4_K_M                ~7.5GB   44.4
8-bit Q8_0                   ~13GB   44.4
4-bit mlx-4bit · mac only   ~6.9GB   44.4
4-bit mlx-8bit · mac only    ~13GB   44.4
</pre>

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>

### Run it on your own machine

**llama.cpp** · install: macOS / Linux `curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh` · Windows `irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex` · [other ways](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md) · Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~7.5GB
llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf lmstudio-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~13GB
llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-GGUF:Q8_0
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf lmstudio-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**LM Studio** · install: [macOS / Windows / Linux](https://lmstudio.ai/download) · Open the app once before using the lms command.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~7.5GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~13GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-GGUF@Q8_0 -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 4-bit mlx-4bit · mac only · ~6.9GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-4bit -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 4-bit mlx-8bit · mac only · ~13GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-8bit -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
```

**Ollama** · install: [macOS / Windows](https://ollama.com/download) · Linux `curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`

```sh
# 4-bit q4_0 · ~7.85GB
ollama run mistral-nemo:12b
# 4-bit q4_k_m · ~7.85GB
ollama run mistral-nemo:12b-instruct-2407-q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0 · ~15.2GB
ollama run mistral-nemo:12b-instruct-2407-q8_0
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~7.5GB
ollama run hf.co/lmstudio-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~13GB
ollama run hf.co/lmstudio-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**MLX (Mac)** · install: with uv `uv tool install mlx-lm` · or `pip install mlx-lm` · Apple silicon Macs only, text only.

```sh
# 4-bit mlx-4bit · mac only · ~6.9GB
mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-4bit
# or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-4bit
# 4-bit mlx-8bit · mac only · ~13GB
mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-8bit
# or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407-8bit
```
